== Notes ==
* This spell works within [[party range]].

* Use it in [[disease]]-heavy areas to reduce the number of victims and prevent the condition from spreading.
* Chain with [[Plague Touch]] or [[Plague Sending]] to transfer conditions to foes.
* Combine with [[Purge Conditions]] or [[Infuse Condition]] to quickly remove several conditions from the party at once.

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] resembles [[Mhenlo]].
* A [[w:Martyr|martyr]] is a person who dies or endures suffering for the sake of a belief, principle, or cause.
